job: Compile strict DesignIntent data into one deterministic graph-backed BuilderDocument proposal and canonical hashes through existing builder factories, with explicit decisions and bounded refusals, without model-authored coordinates, providers, persistence, money, UI, or frozen 3D/design work.

outputs.name: deterministic-compiler-contract-proof
outputs.acceptanceSchema: Playwright deterministic factory and hostile-boundary proof

reject: input is compiled without strict promotion through parseDesignIntent
model-authored coordinates, walls, polygons, room faces, openings, roofs, hashes, timestamps, or project identifiers enter the compiler
a requested room, minimum area, opening count, storey, split level, roof form, or orientation priority is silently dropped, clamped, repaired, or approximated
an unsupported or factory-refused program returns a partial project instead of a bounded refusal
the same intent and compiler version produce different canonical document or proposal hashes
the proposal document fails validateBuilderDocument or its document hash differs from hashBuilderDocument
caller input, factory intermediates, decisions, unresolved questions, source fingerprints, document, graph, or result remain aliased and mutable
a provider SDK or name, network call, credential, model invocation, storage, clock, randomness, wallet, payment, fee, budget, project persistence, React, public UI, or external action enters IP04
an undeclared path changes or the complete candidate write set differs from this manifest
a website 3D, rendering, animation, engine, scene, public visual, model, texture, shader, camera, lighting, motion, or quality-tier path changes
verification: fixture: strict intent promotion rejects unknown keys, geometry, accessors, custom prototypes, and revoked proxies
fixture: same intent and compiler version return identical intent, document, and proposal hashes
fixture: target, range, and disclosed default footprint rules create deterministic half-foot editable graph dimensions without model coordinates
fixture: one and two storeys, requested rooms and minimum areas compile through existing graph factories or return bounded refusals
fixture: supported roofs and exact openings compile through existing factories while unsupported roof, split-level, over-capacity, and impossible programs fail visibly
fixture: deterministic material, climate, siting, and fallback mappings are named in decisions
fixture: validated document hash is hashBuilderDocument output and proposal hash binds compiler version, intent hash, document hash, decisions, unresolved questions, and source fingerprints
fixture: output is detached and deeply frozen without mutating input

static proof: the compiler has no provider, network, secret, storage, clock, randomness, wallet, payment, fee, budget, persistence, React, UI, 3D, renderer, scene, animation, camera, lighting, shader, model, or texture dependency
